The task is to calculate the number-average molecular weight M_n of a polymer sample from the given molecular-weight distribution.
The distribution consists of the following species: 56526 g/mol with a count of 96, 92809 g/mol with a count of 131, 115856 g/mol with a count of 153, and 126029 g/mol with a count of 146.
Use the formula M_n = Σ(N_i · M_i) / Σ(N_i).
Compute Σ(N_i · M_i) = (56526 × 96) + (92809 × 131) + (115856 × 153) + (126029 × 146) = 5426496 + 12157979 + 17725968 + 18400234 = 53710677.
Compute Σ(N_i) = 96 + 131 + 153 + 146 = 526.
Divide: M_n = 53710677 / 526 ≈ 102111.55 g/mol.
Report the final answer rounded to the nearest whole number: M_n ≈ 102112 g/mol.
